name: Rod of the Pact Keeper, +3

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Regain a Pact Magic slot
powers.text: Magic action: regain one expended Pact Magic spell slot (once per Long Rest).

summary: +3 to your Warlock spell attacks and save DC; once per Long Rest, regain a Pact Magic slot.
text: While holding this rod, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your Warlock spells. In addition, you can regain one spell slot from your Pact Magic feature as a Magic action while holding the rod. You can't use this property again until you finish a Long Rest.
